name: Test of Lore
summary: Parqual Fintallas in Undercity asks you to find *The Beginnings of the Undead Threat*. The book is the subject of his request.

sections.title: Parqual's Request
sections.body: The name *The Beginnings of the Undead Threat* is what you seek for Parqual Fintallas in Undercity. You are to bring the book back to him.

faq.answer: Parqual Fintallas asks you to find *The Beginnings of the Undead Threat* and return it to him in Undercity.

faq.q: Where do I return the book?
faq.answer: Return *The Beginnings of the Undead Threat* to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
The book is called *The Beginnings of the Undead Threat*.
